numerical_claims.source_evidence: Concise overview of financial position table shows total equity of EUR 679 million (2024) and EUR 556 million (2023). The candidate value is a reasonable rounding of the source value.

numerical_claims.claim: LHV managed to restore historically ambitious business growth, supported by a strong EUR 1 billion or 28% growth in the loan portfolio
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: '2024 in numbers' section states: 'The loan portfolio increased by EUR 990 million to EUR 4.6 billion (+28% YoY)'. The candidate uses 'EUR 1 billion' as a rounded figure for the growth amount, which is acceptable in this context.

numerical_claims.claim: LHV Bank completed its first full year of operations under a full banking license acquired in 2023, expanding its UK-based corporate portfolio beyond the EUR 300 million mark
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report states: 'In the UK, the corporate portfolio exceeded the EUR 300 million mark by the end of the year.'

numerical_claims.claim: LHV Pank increased its customer base by 38,000 customers or 9% year-over-year to 456,000 customers
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: '2024 in numbers' section states: 'The number of LHV Pank customers increased by 38,000 (+9% YoY) to 456,000.'

numerical_claims.claim: Active everyday payment users increased by 12% to 22,800
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: '2024 in numbers' section states: 'The number of customers actively using LHV Pank for everyday payments increased by 22,800 (+12% YoY).'

numerical_claims.claim: Assets under management by LHV Varahaldus increased by 3% to EUR 1.56 billion primarily due to positive return of the funds
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 1.56 billion (2024), 3% increase from EUR 1.52 billion (2023)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: '2024 in numbers' section states: 'Assets under management increased by EUR 39 million to EUR 1.56 billion (+3% YoY) mainly due to positive return of the funds.'

numerical_claims.claim: LHV Kindlustus achieved consistent growth in market share and profitability, recording its second consecutive profitable year with gross written premiums increasing by 21% to EUR 38.0 million
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_value: EUR 38.0 million (2024), 21% increase from EUR 31.4 million (2023)
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Management report states: 'The annual gross written premiums were EUR 38.0 million (+21% YoY).' Note 27 insurance revenue table confirms EUR 38.0 million for 2024 and EUR 31.4 million for 2023.

numerical_claims.claim: Common Equity Tier 1 ratio of 16.89% and a total capital adequacy ratio of 20.68%
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Regulatory ratios table shows CET1% of 16.89% and CAD% of 20.68% for 2024.
